semantics.how: Builds a reverse edge index and walks it breadth-first from the unit, counting first-level and all reachable callers
semantics.what: Counts direct and transitive callers of a unit
semantics.when: Called by runDiffer for each changed unit
semantics.why: Measures how far a change can propagate

semantics.how: Returns added or removed when one side is missing, otherwise compares struct, text and semantic hashes and line counts to choose modified or unchanged
semantics.what: Classifies a unit's change status, amount and changed fields
semantics.when: Called by runDiffer per matched unit id
semantics.why: Turns hash comparisons into a structured change record

semantics.how: Keys edges by source, target and kind and set-differences the two sides
semantics.what: Lists edges added and removed between two snapshots
semantics.why: Shows dependency changes alongside unit changes

semantics.how: Compares caller counts and public API status of the unit on both sides
semantics.what: Detects a change in a unit's exposure between snapshots
semantics.when: Called by runDiffer for units whose own code did not change
semantics.why: Flags units that became riskier to change without being edited

semantics.how: Combines the change amount, transitive caller count and public API flag into a bounded score
semantics.what: Computes the minimum risk for a change from its size and exposure
semantics.when: Used by runDiffer before any narrated risk
semantics.why: Gives every change a deterministic risk even without an LLM

semantics.how: Checks the unit's exported or public visibility flag
semantics.what: Tells whether a unit is part of the public API
semantics.when: Used by risk scoring and exposure checks
semantics.why: Public units carry higher change risk

semantics.how: Visits each unit recursively, summing child amounts and SLOC and taking risk weighted by size, memoising results
semantics.what: Rolls change amount and risk up to every ancestor unit
semantics.when: Called by runDiffer after unit deltas are built
semantics.why: Lets files, modules and layers show aggregate change

semantics.how: Recurses into children, combines their totals with the unit's own delta and caches the result
semantics.what: Computes the rolled-up amount, risk and SLOC for one unit
semantics.when: Called by rollup for each unit
semantics.why: Memoised recursion keeps the rollup linear

semantics.how: Matches units by id, classifies each change, computes blast radius and formula-floor risk, records exposure changes and group lineage, and rolls amount and risk up the tree
semantics.what: Diffs two snapshots into a delta
semantics.when: Called by analyze, the server and runDifferWithRisk
semantics.why: Deterministic core of change comparison, independent of any provider
